column2: nui naː ʔano moʔomeheu ʔokoʔa ma kanakaː , e like me ka palani , pelekaːne , eʔe moku , a me ʔoːiwi . iwakaːlua paːkeːneka o naː kaːnaka ma kanakaː ʔaʔole i haːnau ma kanakaː , no laila nui naː kaːnaka eʔe moku ke noho nei maʔo . ʔo ka hapa nui o naː kaːnaka eʔe moku ma kanakaː , he mau kaːnaka ʔeulopa , akaː ke ulu nei ka nui o naː kaːnaka mai naː wahi ʔeː aʔe wikipekia ʔelua kaukani iwakaːluakuːmaːono .
